detail:
Realizer pread on a cache miss, reached from the feed reply step with *fnn-extent-no-io* unbound.
Exhibit (every step read): fnn-feed-reply-step (feed-service.lisp:378) runs its body in fnn-owner-transit-serialized (O, class :transit) and calls fnn-owner-feed-arena-step 'fn-owner-feed-reply-chunk (feed-service.lisp:383; owner.lisp:1094, whose docstring says it is 'an entry that READS the payload arena: a 335/238's article is the row's bytes through the arena', books/owner-feed-article.lisp fn-ofa-feed-article = fn-handle-bytes over the arena). The arena read is fn-arena-stored (extent.lisp:1706) -> fn-durable-realize-octets (extent.lisp:1594: with-mutex *fnn-extent-lock* = E, :wait-p t) -> fnn-extent-entry (extent.lisp:1597); on a cache miss with *fnn-extent-no-io* nil (global default extent.lisp:1182; bound true only at owner.lisp:776/803/836/5875, the served read spans, none on the feed path) it calls fnn-extent-entry-direct (extent.lisp:1350, 'a synchronous miss', mode :funded-pool or :offline) -> fnn-extent-read-verified (1254/1295) -> fnn-extent-read-entry (1165) -> fnn-extent-pread (extent.lisp:226-230: fnn-extent-read-stall, then pread(2)). So the pread runs under O (quantum) AND under E (the realizer's own lock).
Keys: R2|fnn-extent-read-entry|O:fnn-extent-pread, R2|fnn-extent-read-entry|E:fnn-extent-pread, R2|fnn-extent-pread|O:sb-alien:alien-funcall, R2|fnn-extent-pread|E:sb-alien:alien-funcall, and the developer-image-only stall hook R2|fnn-extent-read-stall|{O,E}:{probe-file,sleep} (FN_NATIVE_TEST_READ_STALL_FILE; its docstring, extent.lisp:208-214, says every payload pread is 'always off the owner and extent locks', which is false for this synchronous path).
Not claimed: the other core call sites the checker lists for these keys (hybrid-control-author, mux handshake, control status, bp-app ...) are path-insensitive ACL2 closure steps; only the feed reply chunk was shown to read article payloads.
Hazard: a cold article read for a peer feed blocks the owner mutex and the extent mutex (every cold read, pool draw and cache op) for a full disk read; with the read-stall hook or a slow disk, indefinitely. The served-read path avoids this by design (row A4: no-io span, THROW to fnn-extent-cold, off-lock prefetch within ACL2's dependency deadline); the feed path does not use it.
fix: Give the feed reply read the served-read protocol: run the arena read with *fnn-extent-no-io* bound, catch fnn-extent-cold, prefetch the entry off the owner and extent locks within ACL2's dependency deadline, then re-run warm (owner.lisp fnn-owner-chunk-span-no-io is the pattern); or record a decision that the feed path may read synchronously and declare it as a scoped R2 exception with its bound. Also correct the extent.lisp:208-214 docstring.
scenario: A peer feed link receives a 335/238-style reply that makes the owner read an article whose payload extent is not in the realizer cache (cache bound fn-arx-read-cache-entries): the transit quantum preads from disk holding O and E.
source: lock-triage-r2b on lane/lock-triage-r2 (settling the UNSURE keys of lock-triage-r2)
title: Feed reply chunk reads article payloads through the arena realizer: a cache miss does a synchronous pread under the owner and extent mutexes
